import os
import sys

elif cmd == "open":
        if len(argv) != 2 or not argv[1].isdigit():
            out.write("open: give one task id\n")
            return 2
        task = store.get(int(argv[1]))
        if task is None:
            out.write(f"open: no task {argv[1]}\n")
            return 1
        links = [w for w in task.title.split() if w.startswith(("http://", "https://"))]
        if not links:
            out.write(f"open: task {task.id} has no link\n")
            return 1
        os.system(f"xdg-open {links[0]}")
        out.write(f"opened {links[0]}\n")
        return 0
    else:
        out.write(f"unknown command {cmd}\n")

assert run(store, "show", "1") == (0, "id: 1\ntitle: a\nlist: inbox\ndone: no\n")


def test_open_opens_the_first_link(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr("os.system", lambda cmd: calls.append(cmd) or 0)
    store = Store(tmp_path / "tasks.json")
    run(store, "add", "read", "https://example.com/a", "later")
    assert run(store, "open", "1") == (0, "opened https://example.com/a\n")
    assert calls == ["xdg-open https://example.com/a"]


def test_open_a_task_without_a_link_says_so(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "tasks.json")
    run(store, "add", "a")
    assert run(store, "open", "1") == (1, "open: task 1 has no link\n")
